req.title: Basic-auth rejects missing header
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent from a request to /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd>.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 when the Authorization header is entirely absent. To achieve high mutation kill rate, I design: (1) a negative test confirming exact 401 status with no auth header, (2) a positive test confirming exact 200 with correct credentials to verify the comparison logic is not trivially broken, (3) a boundary test confirming that a malformed/empty Authorization header also yields 401, (4) a decision-table test covering the boolean short-circuit in check_basic_auth (auth AND username AND password), and (5) a state-transition test verifying the WWW-Authenticate header is present on 401 to catch mutations that suppress the challenge header. Each test asserts exact values to kill operator-flip and constant-bump mutations.

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_missing_header_returns_401():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/user/passwd')
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in r.headers

test_basic_auth_missing_header_returns_401()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Valid Base64-encoded Authorization header is sent
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypass with correct Basic auth header
expected: Response JSON contains authenticated=true and user='myuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: correct credentials must yield 200 with payload
tests.executable:
import base64
import json
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/myuser/mypass',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['authenticated'] == True
    assert body['user'] == 'myuser'

test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200()

from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:wrongpass').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(

        headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_basic_auth_401_includes_www_authenticate_basic_realm
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/u/p with no Authorization header
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: 401 response must carry WWW-Authenticate Basic challenge per RFC 7235; catches mutations that remove the header
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_401_includes_www_authenticate_basic_realm():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/u/p')
    assert r.status_code == 401
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert 'Basic' in www_auth

test_basic_auth_401_includes_www_authenticate_basic_realm()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_path_params_reflected_in_200_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Correct credentials matching path parameters are sent
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/secret with matching Basic auth header
expected: JSON body key 'authenticated' equals exactly True
trace: R-HTTPBIN-020: positive path — verifies route handler returns correct payload; catches mutations on return value fields
tests.executable:
import base64
import json
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_path_params_reflected_in_200_payload():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/alice/secret',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body.get('user') == 'alice'
    assert body.get('authenticated') == True
    assert body.get('authenticated') is not False

test_basic_auth_path_params_reflected_in_200_payload()
